newsitem.title: USA: Digital $5.3 mln verdict thrown out-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Digital $5.3 mln verdict thrown out-WSJ.

text.p: A $5.3 million jury verdict against Digital Equipment Corp in a keyboard injury case was thrown out by a federal judge in the face of new evidence which indicated the plaintiff's wrist injury was not work-related, the Wall Street Journal said on Wednesday.
A judge in the U.S. District Court in Brooklyn, N.Y. said he would call for a new trail given fresh evidence filed by Digital, the Journal said in its electronic edition.
Among the filings were medical reports showing Patricia Geressy's wrist injury was caused by a neck condition which was not related to her secretarial work, the paper said.
The plaintiff's attorney was quoted in the paper as saying they would appeal the court ruling.
The Journal said the December jury ruling was the largest ever such jury verdict against a computer keyboard maker.
